mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: current temperatures are 64 degrees under clear skies at Fireman's Park, and we are looking at a chilly overnight low of 50 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

Mayor Diaz has proclaimed October as Community Planning Month to honor the Planning and Development Department for their dedication to public service and data-driven community growth. Also, don't forget you can enjoy a free ride on a tri-shaw bike along the Military Ridge State Trail by booking through the Verona Senior Center.

Today features the Dane County Farmer's Market and live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the World Dairy Expo and the Farley Center Fall Festival, followed by yoga and trivia events starting Sunday.
In a noteworthy call from September 21, local officers identified and cited an individual for retail theft after they stole Swedish Fish from a business on East Verona Avenue.
Stop by for a scoop of the delicious Really Reese's flavor of the day. The restaurant is currently open and will be serving until 10:30 PM tonight.
